terminal_reason: BACKLOG-DRAIN-20261015 (session_019p3X1tJAdUdV2dKaw9no8r), 2026-10-15: scripts/ops/prop_feed_tick.sh replaces the permanent tripped marker with capped backoff + one red-flag ping, and prop_executor_tick.sh no longer exits on feed state (4e0133fe, #17253).
what: NO-HALT fix, prop feed: scripts/ops/prop_feed_tick.sh writes <feed dir>/tripped after PROP_FEED_MAX_FAILURES=3 consecutive login failures, the first feasibility stop, or >12 relogins a day. While it exists the feed never logs in again AND scripts/ops/prop_executor_tick.sh exits 0 without running, so the executor halts with it, until 'breakout-login-check apply: reset-feed'. No verbatim operator permission for the halt (commit a1b3d383e quotes only 'Feed now on schedule'). Real constraint: repeated credential logins can lock the prop account, so the retry must back off rather than spin. Fix: replace the permanent trip with exponential backoff (5 min up to a 1 h cap) that keeps retrying, ONE red-flag ping on the 3rd consecutive failure, and let the executor tick run on a reusable session whatever the feed's backoff state.
